lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrAg₂Pd crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—4 Sr, 8 Ag, and 4 Pd—distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 10 geometric neighbors, Pd centers with 9 neighbors, and Sr centers with 16 neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Ag and Pd 9- and 10-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Ag polyhedra, while Sr 16-vertex polyhedra share edges and faces. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
